s1.syndrome_frame: Pituitary dysfunction with visual impairment and multiple hormone deficiencies
salient_findings: Pituitary MRI showing diffuse swelling and a poorly enhancing mass
key_facts: 2-month history of bitemporal hemianopia and left labial numbness
Right abducens nerve palsy on examination
Pituitary MRI showing diffuse swelling of the pituitary body and stalk
7-mm poorly enhancing mass in the right anterior lobe on pituitary MRI
Loss of the posterior pituitary bright spot on T1-weighted images

raw.syndrome_frame: Pituitary dysfunction with visual impairment and multiple hormone deficiencies
salient_findings: Pituitary MRI showing diffuse swelling and a poorly enhancing mass
key_facts: 2-month history of bitemporal hemianopia and left labial numbness
Right abducens nerve palsy on examination
Pituitary MRI showing diffuse swelling of the pituitary body and stalk
7-mm poorly enhancing mass in the right anterior lobe on pituitary MRI
Loss of the posterior pituitary bright spot on T1-weighted images

differentials: Langherans cell histiocytosis with pituitary involvement
Spindle cell oncocytoma of the pituitary
per_call: Langherans cell histiocytosis with pituitary involvement
Spindle cell oncocytoma of the pituitary

shortlist.label: IgG4-related hypophysitis
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated IgG4 levels and pituitary MRI findings consistent with hypophysitis

shortlist.label: Lymphocytic hypophysitis
shortlist.why_kept: Pituitary dysfunction and visual impairment consistent with inflammatory hypophysitis

shortlist.label: Granulomatous hypophysitis
shortlist.why_kept: Pituitary MRI showing diffuse swelling and mass in the right anterior lobe, consistent with granulomatous disease

shortlist.label: Pituitary adenoma
shortlist.why_kept: 7-mm poorly enhancing mass in the right anterior lobe on pituitary MRI, consistent with a pituitary tumor

shortlist.label: Sarcoidosis
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated IgG4 levels and systemic findings, such as lung nodular lesion, consistent with systemic disease

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation of hypopituitarism, elevated IgG4 levels, and imaging findings of diffuse swelling of the pituitary body and stalk are consistent with IgG4-related hypophysitis. The presence of a nodular lesion in the left lung field also suggests systemic IgG4-related disease.

rejected.label: Lymphocytic hypophysitis
rejected.why: While lymphocytic hypophysitis can cause hypopituitarism and pituitary swelling, the elevated IgG4 levels and systemic involvement are more suggestive of IgG4-related hypophysitis.

rejected.label: Granulomatous hypophysitis
rejected.why: Granulomatous hypophysitis can cause pituitary inflammation, but the specific findings of elevated IgG4 levels and systemic IgG4-related disease are not typical of this condition.

rejected.label: Pituitary adenoma
rejected.why: While a 7-mm mass is present in the pituitary gland, the clinical and imaging findings are more consistent with an inflammatory process rather than a pituitary adenoma.

rejected.label: Sarcoidosis
rejected.why: Sarcoidosis can cause granulomatous inflammation in the pituitary gland, but the elevated IgG4 levels and specific imaging findings are more suggestive of IgG4-related hypophysitis.
